references.text: Joshua's death is described here, which Judges 1:1 refers to with the words 'after Joshua's death'
To ask the Lord through the priest using Urim and Thummim, as the children of Israel did in Judges 1:1
A similar situation where the Lord was asked who should go up first against the enemy
The children of Israel asked the Lord 'Which of us shall go up first to battle?' - the same wording as in Judges 1:1
The Canaanites are mentioned as one of the peoples in the land that Israel was to fight against
The Canaanites are mentioned among the people who lived in the land and whom Israel was to defeat
